cards.text: From our founding in 1968 to today’s net-zero commitments, each milestone tells a story of progress — not only in computing power, but in building a greener, more responsible future.
Collaboration with partners, governments, and communities has been key to accelerating sustainable innovation worldwide.
Our focus on energy efficiency, water stewardship, and circularity drives measurable impact across our fabs, supply chain, and products—turning long-term goals into tangible results.
